DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご連絡の方法についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss how we contact you, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 商品紹介の電話が仕事中に来ます。紹介の電話は減らしたいですが、手続きに必要な連絡まで止めたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務中商品電話を減らし取引必要連絡は残したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I get calls introducing products while I am working. I want fewer promotional calls, but I do not want to stop communications needed for procedures as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want fewer product calls at work while keeping necessary transaction communications. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品案内とお取引に必要な連絡を分け、ご希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will distinguish product promotions from communications needed for transactions and confirm your preferences.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話では商品を検討しないので、紹介は資料で見たいです。この希望を担当へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話勧誘でなく本人が資料を読む希望を担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I do not consider products over the phone, so I would like to read information materials instead. Please tell the person in charge of this preference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tell the person in charge that you want to read materials yourself rather than receive telephone solicitations. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人確認の後、現在のご案内の希望を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: After verifying your identity, we will check your current preferences for receiving information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人の資料はこちらです。連絡用の携帯番号は変えていません。案内の受け方だけを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人資料を示し番号変更でなく案内方法変更と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are my identification documents. My mobile contact number has not changed. I am only asking about how I receive promotional information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your identification documents and explain that you are changing the information method, not your number. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 商品紹介の電話を希望しないとして、ご希望を登録しました。必要な連絡は別に行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have registered that you do not wish to receive product promotion calls. Necessary communications will be handled separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その区別でお願いします。紹介の資料を見たくないという希望ではなく、自分で読む形にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紹介電話不希望登録と資料閲覧希望の区別を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please keep that distinction. I am not saying I do not want to see the product materials; I want to read them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the distinction between registering no promotional calls and wanting to read materials. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料のご案内方法はこちらに記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ways to receive information materials are listed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 方法を読みました。仕事中の紹介電話を断る希望が登録されたと確認できたので、必要な取引連絡とは分けて受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 資料方法を読み登録済み希望と必要連絡継続を再確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the methods. I have confirmed that my request to decline promotional calls during work is registered, so I will receive necessary transaction communications separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the material access methods and reconfirm your registered preference and continued necessary communications. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を承りました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your preference. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのチーズをお切りしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Shall I cut this cheese for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。料理に使うので少量欲しいです。見本の丸い物を一つ買うのではなく、切売りでお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 丸見本一つでなく料理用チーズ少量切売りを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want a small amount for cooking. Could I buy a cut portion rather than one whole round like the display sample?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a small cut portion of cooking cheese rather than a whole display round. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品は切売りできます。ご希望の重さはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This product can be sold in cut portions. Do you have a preferred weight?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 百グラムほどです。大きい塊を買って余らせるより、今日使う分にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当日分約百グラムを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: About 100 grams. I would like only what I will use today rather than buy a large block and have some left over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify about 100 grams for today's use. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切った物は百十グラムです。この量でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The cut piece is 110 grams. Is that amount all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 百十グラムで大丈夫です。表示の単価で、その重さの代金を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実切断百十を了承し重さ単価代金を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: 110 grams is fine. I would like to check the price for that weight using the displayed unit price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Accept the actual cut weight of 110 grams and ask to check its price against the weight and unit price. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重さと代金は、このラベルへ印字しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have printed the weight and price on this label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ラベルで確認できました。外側の固い部分を料理に使うかは、自分で説明を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 印字重量価格を確認し固い外側の用途は説明を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the label. I will read the instructions myself to see whether to use the hard outer part in cooking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the printed weight and price and read the instructions about using the hard outside. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存についても、同じラベルをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the same label for storage information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 保存の表示も読みました。この切った百十グラムを買います。包装した分を受け取って、会計へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保存表示後に切売り百十グラム包装分を受け取り会計へ向かう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the storage information too. I will buy this cut portion of 110 grams. I will take the wrapped piece and go to the checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After reading storage information, take the wrapped 110-gram cut portion and go to the checkout. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらをお渡しします。それでは、お料理をお楽しみください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. Enjoy your cooking. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工作会の机は、もう片づけてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: May we clear the craft workshop table now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の粘土の作品がまだ柔らかいので、机から移す方法を聞きたいです。ここで一晩乾かす予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柔らかい粘土作品を机から移す方法を聞き夜預けでないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My clay piece is still soft, so I want to ask how to move it off the table. I am not planning to leave it here overnight to dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to move your soft clay piece off the table and explain that you are not leaving it overnight. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持帰り用の板へ、作品を載せたまま移せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can move it onto a take-home board while keeping it on its base.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その板をお願いします。作品だけつかむと形が崩れそうなので、今の台ごと動かしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 板を求め作品を直接つかまず台ごと移す希望を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please give me that board. Grabbing just the piece might ruin its shape, so I want to move it together with its current base.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the board and say you want to move it with its base without grabbing the piece directly. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の台の下へ、この板を入れてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please slide this board underneath the current base.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 板へ載せられました。袋の底より大きいので、袋へ無理に押し込まず両手で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板に移し袋へ押込まず両手で運ぶと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have placed it on the board. It is bigger than the bottom of the bag, so I will carry it with both hands rather than force it into the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move it onto the board and decide to carry it with both hands without forcing it into a bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの持ち物は、一度まとめてから運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please gather your other belongings together before carrying it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が私のかばんを持ってくれます。私は作品の板だけを水平に持って歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人かばん保持と本人作品板水平保持に分担する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend will carry my bag. I will walk holding only the board with my piece on it, keeping it level.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Divide the tasks so your friend carries your bag and you keep the board with your piece level. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 机に置いていた道具は、こちらへ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return the tools that were on the table here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 道具を戻し、机も空きました。作品は板で持ち帰り、乾かす場所は家で用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 道具返却と机空きを報告し家で乾燥場所を用意する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have returned the tools and the table is clear. I will take my piece home on the board and prepare a place for drying it at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report returning the tools and clearing the table, and say you will prepare a drying place at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お片づけありがとうございました。それでは、作品を大切にお持ち帰りください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for tidying up. Please take your piece home carefully. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 座席のご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a seating preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長い荷物を持つので、窓の景色より荷物置場が近いことを優先したいです。席と置場の位置を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓景色より長荷物置場に近い席を優先し配置図を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a long item of luggage, so I want to prioritize being near the luggage storage over a window view. Could you show me the locations of the seats and storage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Prioritize a seat near storage for long luggage over the window view and ask for a layout diagram. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの図で、置場は車両の端にあります。近い候補は通路側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this diagram, the storage is at the end of the carriage. The nearby option is an aisle seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通路側でお願いします。荷物の大きさも確認したいので、持参した寸法をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路側を希望し持参寸法を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: An aisle seat, please. I also want to check the luggage size, so I will give you the measurements I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request an aisle seat and present the measurements you brought. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この大きさは担当の確認で、こちらの置場をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge has confirmed that luggage of this size can use this storage space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置けることを確認できました。置場が近いこの候補の席を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 置場適合確認後に近い席候補を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have confirmed it can be stored. I will choose this seat option close to the storage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the nearby seat option after confirming your luggage fits the storage. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご案内した席は、この車両と番号です。料金を表示しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The seat I described is in this carriage with this number. I have displayed the fare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 車両と番号、料金を確認しました。現金で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車両番号料金を確認し現金支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the carriage, seat number, and fare. I will pay cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the carriage, number, and fare, and pay in cash. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。こちらが切符です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have confirmed your payment. Here is your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。車両の位置も図で確認できたので、窓側を探し直さず、この通路側の席で行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券受領と配置確認を報告し確定通路席で乗ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. I also checked the carriage location on the diagram, so I will travel in this aisle seat rather than look again for a window seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report receiving the ticket and checking the layout, and say you will travel in the confirmed aisle seat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、荷物に気をつけてご乗車ください。よいご旅行を。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care with your luggage as you board. Have a good trip. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 家具の収集をお申し込みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to arrange furniture collection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい机と椅子を出すつもりでしたが、椅子はまだ使えるので残します。収集は机一つだけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 使用可能椅子を残し小机一つだけ収集依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was going to put out a small desk and a chair, but the chair is still usable, so I will keep it. Please collect only the one desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for collection of only one small desk while keeping the usable chair. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 机の大きさを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the desk's dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 幅はこのメモのとおりです。分解せず、そのまま出す予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 机幅を提示し未分解状態の予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Its width is as written in this note. I plan to put it out as it is, without dismantling it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the desk's width and explain that you plan to leave it assembled. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この内容で確認できました。収集できる日は二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have confirmed those details. There are two possible collection dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 早い方は仕事で出せません。後の水曜を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二候補から出せる水曜を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I cannot put it out on the earlier one because of work. I would like the later date, Wednesday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose Wednesday from the two options because you can put it out that day. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水曜で受付しました。出す場所と時間はこちらの案内で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have booked Wednesday. Please check this information for where and when to put it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 場所と時間を読みました。机は前の日から置かず、指定の時間に出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付後に場所時刻を読み指定時間に机を出すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have read the location and time. I will not leave the desk out from the day before; I will put it out at the designated time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After booking, read the location and time and say you will put out the desk at the designated time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申し込んだ物が分かるよう、この受付の案内を保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep this booking information so you know which item was registered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 机一つ、水曜の収集ですね。控えを持ち帰り、椅子を一緒に出してしまわないよう家族にも机だけと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 机一つ水曜と控えを確認し家族へ対象を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: One desk, collected on Wednesday, correct? I will take the confirmation home and tell my family it is only the desk so the chair does not get put out with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one desk on Wednesday and the receipt, and clearly tell your family which item is included. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お申込みを承りました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your booking has been accepted. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入院中のお食事について、伺いたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about meals during your hospital stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右手で細かい物をつかみにくいので、食事の時に使える道具を先に相談したいです。量を減らしたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右手細物把持が難しく食事量でなく食具相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty picking up small things with my right hand, so I want to discuss utensils I can use at meals in advance. I am not asking to reduce the portions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty grasping small things with your right hand and ask about utensils rather than meal quantity. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段は、どのような道具で食べていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: What utensils do you usually eat with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家では持ち手が太いスプーンを使っています。箸でつかみにくい物も、それなら自分で食べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅太柄スプーンで自食可能と実用具を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: At home I use a spoon with a thick handle. With that, I can eat by myself even things that are difficult to pick up with chopsticks.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your practical utensil and ability to eat independently with a thick-handled spoon at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 病棟で使える道具を確認します。こちらの持ち手はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which utensils can be used on the ward. How is this handle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手に持つと握れます。この形の物を使いたいです。家の物を持参する必要があるかも聞けて助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 示された形を握って適合し同形食具を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: When I hold it, I can grip it. I would like to use this shape. It helps to be able to ask whether I need to bring my own from home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hold the suggested shape, confirm it fits, and choose utensils of that shape. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この道具は病棟でご用意できます。お食事の際にご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide this utensil on the ward. I will pass on your preference for mealtimes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まず自分で食べ、難しい物がある時だけ手伝ってほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 病棟提供を受け自食優先で困難時だけ介助を望む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I would like to eat by myself first, and have help only when there is something difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the ward's utensil and request independent eating first, with assistance only for difficulties. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望も記録しました。ほかに気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have recorded that preference too. Is there anything else you are concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は道具のことだけです。握りやすい物が用意されると分かったので、使いながら困った点をその時に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食具用意を確認し使用中困難があれば都度伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Only the utensils for now. Now that I know easy-to-grip ones will be provided, I will mention any difficulties as they arise while using them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the utensils will be provided and say you will report difficulties during use each time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お食事の準備へ申し送ります。それでは、入院日にお待ちしております。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass this on to the meal preparation staff. We look forward to seeing you on admission day. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何がありましたか。こちらでお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What happened? We can listen here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駅前で知らない人に腕をつかまれました。振りほどいて離れ、ここまで来ました。今も腕が痛いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 成人本人が駅前で腕をつかまれ離れて来署し現在痛みを申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A stranger grabbed my arm in front of the station. I pulled free, moved away, and came here. My arm still hurts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: As an adult speaking for yourself, report being grabbed by the arm in front of the station, escaping, coming to the police station, and current pain. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、その方は近くにいらっしゃいますか。お怪我の様子も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that person nearby now? I will check your injury too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 離れてからは見ていません。この腕の赤い所が痛みます。人がいる受付前で話すのは落ち着かないので、別の所で話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手現所在不明と赤い腕の痛みを示し私的相談席を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not seen them since I moved away. This red part of my arm hurts. I feel uncomfortable talking in front of reception with people around. Can we talk somewhere else?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you do not know the person's current location, show the painful red area of your arm, and ask for a private consultation seat. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの相談席へご案内します。まず起きた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will take you to this consultation seat. First, tell me where it happened.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅の南側の時計の前です。相手が声を掛け、私が急いでいると返した後、腕をつかまれました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅南時計前と呼止め返答後把持の順序を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: In front of the clock on the south side of the station. The person spoke to me, and after I replied that I was in a hurry, they grabbed my arm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the location by the clock south of the station and the sequence of being addressed, replying, and being grabbed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その後、ご自身はどの方向へ離れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: After that, in which direction did you move away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計からこちらの通りへ歩きました。走ることはできず、角の店の前で一度止まってから警察署へ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 離脱方向と角店前一時停止後来署の経路を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I walked from the clock toward this street. I could not run, and stopped once in front of the corner shop before coming to the police station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the direction you left and the route, including stopping at the corner shop before coming to the police station. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所と経過を確認しました。腕の状態と今後の対応を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have confirmed the location and sequence. I will hand over your arm's condition and the next steps to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今はこの席で待ちたいです。腕の痛みも含めて話せたので、担当の方へ続けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全な相談席待機を希望し現在痛み込みで担当相談を継続する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I would like to wait in this seat for now. I have been able to explain things, including my arm pain, so I will continue consulting the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to wait in the safe consultation seat and continue consulting the person in charge, including your current pain. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ここでお待ちください。担当へすぐにおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here. I will connect you with the person in charge right away. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の送り方をお決めになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided how to send your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。家の秤は細かい数字が読めなかったので、ここで重さを測ってから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅秤不鮮明で受付実測後に小包方法を選びたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I could not read the fine numbers on my scale at home, so I want to have it weighed here before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the home scale was unclear and you want to choose the parcel method after weighing it at the counter. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。包んだ状態のまま載せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check here. Please put it on as it is, wrapped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この状態でお願いします。中身は本一冊で、梱包の用意は済んでいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 梱包済本一冊を現状態で測定依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please weigh it in this state. It contains one book, and I have finished preparing the packaging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to weigh the already packaged single book in its current state. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 重さを確認できました。この条件で使える方法は二つあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked the weight. There are two methods available under these conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急がないので、安い方を選びたいです。それぞれに追跡があるかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急がず低費用希望に加え二方法追跡有無を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is not urgent, so I would like the cheaper one. Please also tell me whether each has tracking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain it is not urgent, request low cost, and ask whether each of the two methods has tracking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この二つでは、こちらの方法に追跡があります。料金はこの表示のとおりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Of these two, this method has tracking. The prices are as displayed here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 追跡のある方にします。測った重さでの料金を確認できたので、その額を支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実測料金を確認し追跡付き方法を選んで支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose the one with tracking. I have confirmed the price for the measured weight, so I will pay that amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the price based on the measured weight, choose the tracked method, and pay. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。発送の控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have confirmed your payment. Here is your mailing receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取りました。家の秤の読み方で悩んだまま選ばず、重さと使える方法を受付で確認して発送できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発送控えを受領し実測方法確認後の発送完了を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have it. Rather than choosing while still worrying about how to read my home scale, I was able to confirm the weight and available methods at the counter and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the mailing receipt and report completing shipment after checking the measured weight and method. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりいたします。それでは、ご利用ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take care of it. Thank you for using our service. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 取引の明細をご希望ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家計を見直すため、四月と五月を月ごとに見たいです。一続きの期間でも別の紙へ分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家計見直し用四五月明細を月別紙で発行できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to review my household finances, so I would like to see April and May by month. Even though it is one continuous period, can you separate them onto different sheets?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether April and May statements for reviewing household finances can be issued on separate monthly sheets. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発行できる形式を確認します。この窓口では月ごとに分けてお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the available format. This counter can provide them separately by month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: それでお願いします。四月一日から末日、五月一日から末日までの二つです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各月初末を指定して二期間発行を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do that. Two periods: April 1 to the last day of April, and May 1 to the last day of May.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the first and last day of each month and request statements for the two periods. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の確認と、対象の口座を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will verify your identity and the relevant account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料はこちらです。この口座だけの明細をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人資料を示し対象一口座を明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here are my documents. Please provide statements for this account only.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your identification documents and specify the one account concerned. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの条件と費用をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check these conditions and fees.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認しました。二か月分の発行をお願いします。家のノートと見比べる時、月の境目が分かる形が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件費用了承し月境界が分かる二か月発行を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked them. Please issue the two months' statements. I need a format that clearly shows the boundary between months when comparing them with my notebook at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Accept the conditions and fees and request two months' statements with clear monthly boundaries. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 四月分と五月分を発行しました。期間をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have issued the April and May statements. Please check the periods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それぞれの最初と最後の日を確認できました。二枚を月別の袋へしまって持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発行二明細の開始終了日を照合し月別袋へ収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the first and last dates of each. I will put the two sheets into separate monthly envelopes to take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Compare the start and end dates on the two statements and put them into separate monthly envelopes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明細をお渡ししました。それでは、お忘れ物のないように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have received the statements. Please be sure not to leave anything behind. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お困りですか。こちらのサービスカウンターで伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help? We can assist at this service counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 買い物中に六歳の娘とはぐれました。私は青い上着で、娘は黄色の服を着ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 娘とはぐれたことと親子の服装をサービスカウンターで伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I got separated from my six-year-old daughter while shopping. I am wearing a blue jacket, and my daughter is wearing yellow.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the service counter you are separated from your daughter and describe both your clothing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お子さんのお名前と、最後に一緒にいた売場を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your child's name and the section where you were last together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は美緒です。三分ほど前、パン売場で私が商品を戻している間に見えなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子どもの名前と最後に一緒にいた売場・経過時間を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Her name is Mio. About three minutes ago, I lost sight of her while putting an item back in the bread section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your child's name, the section where you were last together, and the elapsed time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場の係へ連絡しました。ここにいていただければ、見つかったお子さんを係がこちらへ案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have contacted the section staff. If you stay here, staff will bring the child here when found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このカウンターで待ちます。娘には、困った時は店員さんのそばにいてと伝えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 係が子どもを案内する場所としてカウンターで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait at this counter. I have told my daughter to stay near a store employee if she needs help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait at the counter as the place where staff will bring your child. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係がお子さんと戻ってきました。こちらのお子さんで間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member has returned with a child. Is this your child?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、美緒です。私の顔を見てこちらへ来ました。見つけていただき、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 係に連れられて来た子どもが自分の娘だと確認し礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it is Mio. She saw my face and came toward me. Thank you for finding her.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the child brought by staff is your daughter and thank them. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人が一緒になったことを係にも伝えました。お買い物の品は、このかごに置いたままでしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have also told staff that you are reunited. You left your shopping in this basket, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、このかごも受け取ります。娘と手をつないで、買い物の続きへ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分のかごを受け取り娘と手をつないで買い物へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will take this basket too. I will hold my daughter's hand and return to continue shopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take your own basket and return to shopping holding your daughter's hand. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お二人でゆっくりお買い物ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-26210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take your time shopping together. Thank you.
